narrative.overview: CPSI LABS presents real software disciplines and products with clear benefits, genuine media, and concise explanation. White is the default canvas; pale gray, black, and navy bands create deliberate contrast. The centered brand hero features the original CS monogram, CPSI LABS, the exact Build. Innovate. Evolve. slogan, a short vision, and two direct actions. Existing theme and language preferences remain intact.

rules.name: Benefit before implementation
rules.body: Lead with the real user benefit and understandable explanation before platform or implementation detail.

rules.name: Rectilinear brand frame
rules.body: The precision showcase uses rectangular alignment guides around one blue frame. The genuine CS monogram remains unmodified in the brand hero; do not reintroduce the former orbital paths.
